messages:
maria: hey team — quick async handoff for the nightbridge preflight (t-6h). what I did: preloaded KV cache on canary nodes, ran the warmup script, and validated health checks. blockers: one pod in us-west-2 kept hitting OOM and failing liveness — currently bisecting. today: i'll scale that node down, roll the warmup patch, and re-run stress. pinging @josh for traffic ramp plan and @kaori for a fast CR review.
josh: thanks — can you paste the OOM log snippet? i can shift a small traffic slice off us-west while you debug. plan is 1% -> 5% in 30m if health stays green.
maria: snippet below (truncated):
```
runtime: out of memory
panic: could not allocate 512MB buffer
...
GC: pause 120ms, heapsize 12GB -> 13GB
```
it's for model `redwood-infer-v2-7b` on g5.2x, memory spike during long-context warmups. repro steps: run `./scripts/warmup --ctx 8192 --iter 50` against the canary endpoint.
kaori: on it — reviewing PR #1243 now. left an inline comment about backoff timing; if we adjust from 500ms to 300ms it should smooth retries. expect to merge in ~20–30m if nothing else pops up.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary-warmup job finished for nightbridge-3 — all checks passed. logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/2371 (artifact: warmup-logs.tar.gz)
josh: ok i'll hold the slice at 1%. @maria if you can't stabilise within 45m let's fallback to the quantized variant for that slice.
maria: agreed. tagging @sam for LB weight ops — we might need manual 0.5% nudges via console rather than terraform.
sam: standing by — i can nudge ingress weights manually. let me know when to make the first +0.5% bump. i'll watch alerts while you patch.
kaori: merged PR; pushed a patch to warmup to reduce peak allocations by ~10% (streamed tensor zeroing + staggered batch warms). rolling to canary in ~5m.
maria: thanks! once the new warmup is live i'll restart the failing pod and post an update.
maria: update 3782468137: restarted pod, liveness stable, no OOM observed during a 20m stress window. @josh you can advance to 5% when ready. :thumbsup:
